title: Equidifferent
summary: EQUIDIF'FERENT, adjective Having equal differences; arithmetically proportional. In crystalography, having a different number of faces presented by the prism and by each summit; and these three number

inlines.v: EQUIDIF'FERENT, adjective Having equal differences; arithmetically proportional. In crystalography, having a different number of faces presented by the prism and by each summit; and these three numbers form a series in arithmetical progression, as 6.4.2.
